notes.title: WitchHand: PHOENIX FIRE - Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/f620580e9953db12105ffd8df9ac08023ae3927f.png[/img]
[h3]Rise of the Phoenix[/h3]
The Phoenix Witch is here! Warriors? Merchants? Who needs em. The phoenix is the only familiar this witch needs. Keep it happy and trained and it will reward you with faster crafting times and bonus resources. If you can find the elusive Phoenix Tamer, they may even be able to grant you new abilities that benefit both your phoenix and your witch.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/148caf09666631d1f32f8e77dd133ef33b2300ff.gif[/img]
[h3]German, Polish, and French[/h3]
Three new languages have come to WitchHand! The game will try to use your computer's default language if possible or you can set it yourself at any point in the options menu.

It's been super cool to finally get the opportunity to localize one of my games. The folks at Level Up Translation are real pros and I'm pumped to bring the game to new players.

[h3]Progression and Balance Changes[/h3]
I changed up a bunch of stuff! Many research paths have been revamped, some buildings have been totally reworked, Waypoints are easier to craft, and much more! Full patch notes below.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/81a52996a69f086416e7532bb176b9689b64c41a.png[/img]
[h3]Nexus-In-A-Box[/h3]
The game-changing Nexus may be acquired much earlier in a run by cracking open the unique Nexus-In-A-Box, gifted from your home realm. Enjoy the large amount of early game storage space and building automation!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/820bdbd791420c1f3fd8a64807795e23de4f052c.png[/img]
[h3]More Choices![/h3]
When completing a Golden Quest by paying 20 Stardrop Coins, you're now offered a choice of reward. Because sometimes you'd rather have a sword instead of another cat.

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
- language setting added to options
- two new achievements
- buying explore cards tutorial now also explains selling cards
- new tutorial for familiar corpses
- new video added to first spell purchase tutorial
- first waypoint tutorial explains slotting it to increase explore level
- waypoints renamed to "Waypoint: First", "Waypoint: Second" etc.
- waypoints' recipes now cheaper
- Trader now guaranteed to always have Reagents in stock
- Trader/Trade Hub now sells reagents in bundles of 2 instead of 3
- Void Core added to Trader's possible resources for sale
- Trader now arrives every 8 days instead of 10
- golden quest completion now prompts a choice of reward
- second letter from home now includes a Nexus-In-A-Box
- Magnet: Fireball no longer pulls shackled enemies
- Village in a Bottle Spell prerequisite changed to Capri Pen from Gem Forge
- gem heart removed from Village in a Bottle Spell recipe
- Spell Archive building now creates Spell Pages, recipe changed to Capri Horn x2
- exploring can no longer create multiple enemies in a row
- first time exploring a level 1 explore card always gives a capri
- first time exploring a level 2 explore card always gives a gem deposit
- only record cards now allowed in the jukebox
- storage chest cost reduced to crystal x3 from crystal x4
- storage chest spell now requires population growth, crystal quarry, and herbalist spells instead of first waypoint spell
- first waypoint spell now requires storage chest spell
- waypoints in spell choice now list some of the cards unlocked in the next tier
- cards in the compendium now display their stats (attack, health, value, etc.)
- compendium entries specific to a certain witch now display that witch's icon
- Healing Touch spell cast time decreased to 10 seconds from 15 seconds
- Renewed Village base slots increased to 4 from 3
- Fated Judge now demands 1,000,000 coins, up from 1,000
- placed card stacks now fall into place almost immediately
- jumping cards may now pass through haze on the way to their destination
- increased chance to receive reagents from exploring if you don't have any
- fixed infection event crash if there's suddenly no faerie cities
- fixed card compendium Cards Found count sometimes exceeding the maximum
- fixed board expansion left void nests spawning too far up for some reason
- fixed spellbook button rollover misalignment

notes.title: PHOENIX FIRE - Coming June 27th
notes.content:
WitchHand's big update and new character are nearly upon us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/b6da4b345ff84aab3a836c52a34ed35c747b6d9f.png[/img]

[h3]New Witch![/h3]
The Phoenix Witch is nearly here! Warriors? Merchants? Who needs em. The phoenix is the only familiar this witch needs. Keep it happy and trained and it will reward you with faster crafting times and bonus resources. If you can find the elusive Phoenix Tamer, they may even be able to grant you new abilities that benefit both your phoenix and your witch.

[h3]German, Polish, and French[/h3]
Three new languages are coming to WitchHand! It's been super cool to finally get the opportunity to localize one of my games. The folks at Level Up Translation are real pros and I'm pumped to bring the game to new players.

[h3]Progression and Balance Changes[/h3]
I changed up a bunch of stuff! Many research paths have been revamped, the game-changing Nexus may be acquired much earlier in a run, Waypoints are easier to craft, and much more! (full patch notes to come with release!!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/f620580e9953db12105ffd8df9ac08023ae3927f.png[/img]

notes.title: New Character Sneak Peek
notes.content:
I've been hard at work getting the new witch character ready! Here's a sneak peek!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/8784b6f94faf2503859eee0c905ef55d65e5caff.png[/img]
[h3]The Phoenix[/h3]
Unlike the other witches in WitchHand, the Phoenix Witch needs only one familiar: the Phoenix. The Phoenix has the potential to become very powerful if well taken care of. When happy, it has an increasing chance to produce double resources when crafting. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/d0f49690776c89d2a8f3f269b4579199f211f910.png[/img]
Because the familiar training buildings no longer have familiars to train, they instead buff the Phoenix in various ways. For example, the Sorcerer's School allows the Phoenix to cast spells and increases its cast speed. Slotting additional Sorcerer's Schools will increase the cast speed even further. With the right set up, a happy enough Phoenix will complete many tasks almost instantly.

You'll also be able to discover new cards that strengthen both your Phoenix and your witch. My current favorite is the Everburning Bond, which allows stat increases to the witch to also apply to the Phoenix, and vice versa.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/e23efdccf34d88aa0a001f9ed2363cb917eea3f1.png[/img]

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
More than just adding a new playable character, the Phoenix Update will also be making many changes to the balance and progression of the game. Many cards will have their recipes updated, their unlock conditions changed, and in a few cases, their usage totally reworked (looking at you, Spell Archive!)

Also! You'll be getting a special gift from your home realm after building the First Waypoint. Returning players can look forward to a revamped play experience and new players can go in knowing that the experience has been polished to a mirror shine.

Can't wait to share more.
Jon

notes.title: Fated Future - WitchHand Update and News
notes.content:
Hello friends! Happy WitchHand release week! Thank you to everyone who played the game and left a review and thank you for everyone's feedback and all around good vibes. It's been an exciting time over here!

Let's get right into WitchHand's first post-launch update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/f194c738726b91eb6af62b2103871878cf0afb3f.gif[/img]

[h3]Fated Future[/h3]
We got three (3) new cards!
[list]
[*] [b]Fated Delegate[/b] - Fated Quests that ask for a tribute of resources may be slotted here. They will automatically pull the cards they need from a Nexus. Requires Autocaster, Blacksmith, and Armory spells to learn.
[*] [b]Magnet: Fireball [/b]- Newly created attack spell cards (Fireball, Shackle, Freeze etc.) will be pulled here. Learned alongside the base Magnet spell. (existing save files will automatically have this spell added to their spellbooks)
[*] [b]Burial Spell [/b]- Permanently lays Corpse cards to rest. Creates 2 random resources. A good way to use up Corpse cards that you do not intend on reviving. Requires the Revival spell to learn.
[/list]
Over the past week, I've also put out a few patches that -- amongst the bug fixes -- included new features like:

- support for widescreen displays
- villages now have production toggles that toggle all slotted buildings
- can now click during most end of day events to skip through them (Turn on "Fast Witching Hour" in the options to get through them even faster)
- "Allow Camera Pan with Interact" setting added to controls screen
- card symbols added to temple of rites outline sprite

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/f19ac0c4aef530589f7b255542ce9be56be1ec30.png[/img]

[h3]Yooo We Got Trading Cards![/h3]
Steam approved WitchHand for community items! :wh_cat:

I'm excited to see my art in those official Steam card frames. I don't know. It just feels really good.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/34b13796852e110811a4fd936ac80bcbb7a94b84.png[/img]

[h3]What's Next for WitchHand?[/h3]
Good question! A lot of things are still up in the air as I balance continued WitchHand support with other ongoing projects. I don't want to make any grand promises on what I wish or hope to do for this game. That said, the game will be getting, at the very least, one (1) new witch. Stay tuned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/5e97618d0446c0b2fc1fd261520b71e0b96d461e.png[/img]

[h3]Patch Notes (additional)[/h3]
- swords, shields, flame cake, armored smoothie now have better tooltips when being used
- fixed source cards able to craft on top of enemies
- fixed explore tooltips not showing the correct explore contents
- fixed collapsed village outline collision not factoring for the radiant beacon max seven slots

[h3]Closing Thoughts[/h3]
Thank you. I've made three games now and this one is far and away my most successful* game (in terms of sales and reception). Thank you for making that happen. I appreciate all of you.

<3
Jon

notes.title: Sacrifices, Bribes, and Chaos - WitchHand Devlog
notes.content:
Hello friends! I'm here to tell you about some new features coming in the full WitchHand release! Let's get right into it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/142f0c3f7144f5633db9a03bc5ae830e47753dc6.gif[/img]
[h3]It's the Rite Time[/h3]
The Temple of Rites allows you to perform a variety of rites with unique effects you won't get anywhere else. Want to block all damage to your witch for a night? Temporarily boost the attack of all your familiars? All you need is the right cards to sacrifice! And don't worry, if you're not excited about sacrificing your favorite warrior cat named Gregory, you might be able to find alternative options.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/63ff98267cb430842cfa055478927037a438fda4.png[/img]
[h3]Bribery![/h3]
Not a fan of your Faerie neighbors? Maybe they're not selling the thing that you want? Don't want to kill them in cold blood? Then bribery is the answer! A peaceful solution, simply give them some money and they'll leave! But! If you do decide to keep them around, they might provide some extra services once they become friendly.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/79ea2eb49c74d423c8386e3c3091a68f1e73d0e7.png[/img]
[h3]CHAOS CHAOS[/h3]
The Chaos Witch really likes attacking stuff! So much so that they don't allow any of their familiars to attack. To help the witch take on every enemy all on their own, they have a lot of options to beef up and quickly become overpowered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/7a6c59738713a3c9034775a9c69b6c6363b6dd68.gif[/img]
Skulls from defeated enemies are used as offerings to the Chaos Gateway, which in return rewards the Chaos Witch with new abilities and, you guessed, the opportunity to get more skulls per skull. It's skulls all the way down and you can never have enough.

[h3]Oh Yeah and I Updated the Demo[/h3]
The demo got an update that featured a pretty heavy polish pass. Many things now look and feel better! Also there's a new land and village that increase Silversage production speed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/0bed3280b690fe131baba762359e40aeccf28e11.png[/img]

I gotta get back to work, but thanks for reading! 

See you next time,
Jon

notes.title: Halloween Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello friends, happy spooky time! On this, the spookiest of days, I come to you with a WitchHand demo update! Let's get right into it.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/e0e1eac78b9cf09cc9aedc7e3c9934e2fd9da7dd.png[/img]
[h3]Burn Burn Burn[/h3]
The hands-off approach to setting your enemies on fire. Fireballs are a bit pricey to cast but keep your familiars out of harms way. The fireball spell will become available to learn once you've learned the Sorcerer's School spell.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/945c9c9f858b89d1841b9e2873d6d4a534e38eb6.gif[/img]
[h3]Familiar Tracker[/h3]
I kept losing track of my apprentice familiar, so I made a tracker to do it for me! The familiar tracker automatically displays an icon for each of your little buddies, even letting you know if they're currently crafting or are in battle! You also get a bit more info by selecting their icon. And the best part is that when you can click their icon, your camera will move to their location! Never lose a familiar again with the official WitchHand Familiar Tracker™.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/5fe4810a87994b57871b93ca0d63c6d27154c7e4.gif[/img]
[h3]Village Collapsing[/h3]
Like cards but want to see less of them? Double-click on any village to collapse their slots! It's fun! Collapsed cards remain fully functional, they just get smaller and cuter.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/03822ead9b7fa1d9e7af37bc36d2b52a7b52f961.gif[/img]
[h3]Spellbook Grid View[/h3]
This was a highly requested one! You'll now be able to toggle the spellbook between list and grid views. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/4ffe65d5f0fcb840ef11c670f878b4fa2e38ced7.png[/img]
[h3]Production Toggle[/h3]
Have too many mana extractors chewing through your crystals? Click the toggle and power them off until you need them!

[h3]Bigger Chests[/h3]
There's larger chests later in the full game but I figured why not increase storage size across the board? Storage Chests can now store up to 60 cards! (Might only take effect on new saves!)

[h3]Full Patch Notes[/h3]
- spell page card now found in explore level 1
- can now pan camera with middle mouse button. Keybinding can be changed in controls screen. Try panning while grabbing a card!
- new sound for potions
- new options: Display Day Timer Seconds, Pause Game When Minimized
- all lands now have a value of 0 until the first village is created, allowing the player to hold onto their first beacon if they want
- longer card names now break into two lines
- cards now jump further to reach stacking opportunities
- cards are now much smarter about jumping into empty places
- cards jumping to a stack or chest that becomes full now create a new stack with any other cards that were jumping to the same place
- cards now resolve bouncing off other cards much faster and smoother
- village outlines now bounce off each other
- storage chest size increased to 60 from 30
- silversage created by an herbalist now always stacks onto that herbalist
- slotted building card tooltips now show in addition to card stack details
- increased the strength of later void rifts
- clicking on the hud witch portrait now moves the camera to your witch card
- added autobuying tutorial
- added time played to save select
- improved environment performance
- fixed exiting controls screen also exiting options screen
- fixed cards created by the spellbook sometimes appearing underneath it
- fixed being able to pan camera or pick up cards while dragging the spellbook scrollbar
- fixed cursor lag on some computers
- fixed the spell choice and end of day screens having a chance to occur at the same time
- fixed buildings jump stacking onto slotted buildings, cancelling their timers

[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
- In-game familiar tracker turns invisible when changing to/from fullscreen. Fixed by saving and reloading.

notes.title: What's to Come - WitchHand Devlog
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/242fdf88b9d67d6b58658e4305ffe64ea2d4adc2.png[/img]
Hello friends! I've been hard work on WitchHand and the good news is that I have a lot of new features to share! But before I get into that, I want to say thank you to everyone who has played the demo. Your feedback has been great and really pushed the game to be greater. The demo has gotten a positive reception over the past few months -- especially from the previous two demo festivals -- and I'm stoked to finally share more about its future. If you haven't played the most recent version of the demo, you should check it out! I've made a ton of improvements to it (again thanks to feedback!)

That said... what's coming to WitchHand?!?!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/86fed2e0e46cd59dc621793e9f682b855777282e.gif[/img]
[h3]Automation with the Nexus[/h3]
A mid-game village type, the Nexus will allow all buildings to automatically pull the resources they need from the Nexus' chests. The Nexus chests also function as magnet chests, meaning they will pull new resources to themselves from anywhere. Which is good because soon your playing space will be bigger than ever!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/b3a7455729a76f970c89ca2dcc2d98619b4520c8.gif[/img]
[h3]Expanding Playing Space[/h3]
During your explorations, you will sometimes encounter the Fortune Teller. Pay her fee and watch as she expands your opportunities for growth. Sometimes it's dangerous though, so watch out for that.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/457c328d268e8258101ad7561c5743b654a0c461.png[/img]
[h3]But will there be Bosses?[/h3]
There will be! Let me tell you about the first one: Encountered while exploring the Void Ruins, Void Lords always come with a few of their little shieldling buddies. These shieldlings will need to be defeated before you can damage their boss, but doing so might net you a unique item that will help you keep your witch alive.

[h3]Any other juicy secrets? That can't be it?[/h3]
Nah, but here's a tombstone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/752a7715920d5d43160ed8004ed8b88d59102668.png[/img]

I gotta get back to work, but thanks for reading! 

See you next time,
Jon

notes.title: WitchHand Demo Patch 0.7.3

Hey friends, here's a quick update to the WitchHand demo! Everything in here is a direct result of player feedback. Thank you to everyone who played and provided the feedback and bug reports for these changes!

Here's the full changelog. It's mostly minor tweaks and fixes but I also snuck in some new content for ya:

- new land card: Barrens
- new village card: Barrens Village - "Slotted familiar training buildings receive +100% production speed. Familiars trained here gain +1 armor. Armor cannot exceed Familiar's max health."
- new faerie village that purchases lightning glem cards
- new faerie village that purchases capri horn cards
- void bramble, void ogre, void giant slime added to later void rift summons
- extra white border added to pause vignette
- healing touch and healing wave spells now say "cast" instead of "create" in their tooltips
- waypoint spell tooltips now mention that they increase the spells available to research
- game over screen now has an exit choice, quits to title screen without restarting or saving
- camera manual pan speed increased by current zoom amount
- "defeat an enemy" quest can no longer spawn in peaceful mode
- cards used to manually make a purchase now no longer allowed to stack onto other cards, sometimes causing crazy collision slowdown
- fixed familiars sometimes being consumed in unrelated building recipes
- fixed game window defaulting to a tiny tiny size

Oh and I added a new opening when creating a new save :)

notes.title: Friends and Foes - Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello friends! I got a big update to the WitchHand demo for you. Let's get right into it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/55333750d39463cfccfcaa8108fde7cbc25b6643.gif[/img]

[h3]Custom Familiar & Village Names[/h3]
Shift+click on any Familiar or Village to give it a custom name.

[h3]New Familiar[/h3]
The Envoy, trained by an Embassy, is better able to make friends with Faeries. Especially if they're mad at you! The Envoy is also capable of befriending enemy Faerie units, bringing them under your control.

[h3]New Enemies[/h3]
Six new enemies will appear from Void Rifts on the new moon. They're tough! And one of them might even drop something that your familiars will like.

[h3]Auto Buying[/h3]
You may now shift+click on the Explore and Spells buttons to complete the transaction automatically, without needing to drag the necessary cards over. 

[h3]Card Locking[/h3]
Right click on any card to lock it in place. This prevents it from being pushed around by other cards. Can be given a custom keybinding in the controls menu.

[h3]Peaceful Mode[/h3]
A chill game mode where no enemies will spawn! Set on a new save during character select.

[h3]Auto-Pausing Option[/h3]
Turning auto-pausing on in the options will automatically pause the day timer while dragging cards.

[h3]New Cards[/h3]
- Envoy Familiar, Embassy
- Bog land, Bog Village
- Void Spike, Void Slime, Small Void Slime, Void Icicle, Void Cocoon, Void Emergence

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224141/0409a1dc4efc0f0e0f17abaadb4849cab59a9ef9.png[/img]

[h3]Full Patch Notes[/h3]
- two new music tracks added
- new card back art
- newly created cards try harder to jump into empty spaces
- enemy attack/health icons move to the sides so that they are visible while in combat
- all land cards are now possible to find while exploring from the start of the game
- cards stack more tightly together now
- rebalanced card results from exploring
- improved spell card tooltips readability 
- updated many cards' flavor text
- new sound for cards placed into chests
- new sound for warriors attacking cities
- spell cards now craft when there are non-relevant cards in the stack (buildings already did this)
- spell card tooltips now show in addition to card stack details
- faerie city tooltips now display extra information when friendly
- increased maximum camera zoom
- stardrops from selling now auto enter nearby stardrop chests
- spawn familiar quest no longer spawns if at familiar cap
- clicking a card to open/retrieve now easier to execute, especially when zoomed out
- cards now bounce off of each other much more smoothly
- villages now better prevent themselves and their outlines from going inside of walls
- cards accidentally spawned out of bounds now better reenter playable space
- many performance improvements for when hundreds of cards are on screen
- Healing Touch and Healing Wave cast times halved.
- Terrain Recycler recipe changed, now crafts any 2 land cards into 1 Reagents. Craft time halved.
- combat time decreased to 6 seconds from 8 seconds
- fixed spells crafting while stacked on a slotted building
- fixed newly created storage chests sometimes stacking into themselves
- fixed cards sometimes forgetting what card they're on top of after being restacked
- fixed a crash caused by pressing the Sell and Interact keys on a stack of cards at the same time
- fixed silversage created by herbalist not stacking consistently
- fixed crafting getting confused and halting when there are multiple explore cards and crystal deposit cards in the same stack

notes.title: Demo Update - Fixes & Quality of Life
notes.content:

- fixed Familiars Homes increasing the familiar cap when stacked on top of each other
- fixed multiple familiars summoning at once and exceeding the familiar cap
- fixed music tracks overlapping on game over restart
- fixed hud negative familiar count on game over restart
